summary: Cerence Inc. filed an 8-K on August 5, 2026, announcing quarterly results and a new stock repurchase program. The Board authorized up to $30 million in share buybacks starting August 10, 2026, via open market, private, block, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. Repurchases are subject to market conditions and may be suspended anytime. No obligation to buy a specific number, and no price or premium terms stated. The program supplements ordinary capital return and is not tied to a broader strategic deal. Watch for buyback execution pace and any suspension given operational volatility.
